title: Patched.im Device Posture
description: Response schema for GET /v1/posture. Versioned; increment schema_version on breaking changes.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Currently 1. Increment on breaking changes to this document.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this response was generated.

device.description: Device identity and metadata. Derived from the credential — never client-supplied.

tier.description: Agent subscription tier from the signed agent-config. UI uses this to gate actions honestly.

app_count.description: Number of distinct applications currently installed on the device.

benchmarks.description: One entry per benchmark evaluated on this device (e.g. CIS + patched.im baseline).

implemented.description: Rules with at least one evaluation for this device.

benchmark_total.description: Total enabled rules defined in the benchmark for this platform. UI renders 'implemented of benchmark_total'.

compliance_pct.description: passed / (passed + failed + errors) × 100. not_applicable excluded from denominator.

section.description: CIS section number extracted from rule_key (e.g. '1', '2', '5').

evidence.description: Audit evidence: coverage window, scan count, report digest.

coverage_window_days.description: Rolling window over which scans_logged is counted. Currently 30.

scans_logged.description: Successful extractions for this device within the coverage window.

last_signed_report_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the most recently generated compliance PDF for this device. Null if no report has been generated. Written by ComplianceReportHandler into device_report_digests; read back here as posture evidence.

recent_scan_times.description: Timestamps of the five most recent successful scans, newest first.

findings.description: CVE findings for installed apps, sourced from device_cve_findings (populated by patched-cve-sync). Ordered by cvss_v3_score DESC. Empty array when no findings exist.

description_source.description: Upstream source for a non-empty description. Empty only when description is empty.

cvss_v3_score.description: CVSS v3 base score. Null when NVD has no CVSS v3 record.

match_confidence.description: version_confirmed: version range from NVD matched the installed version. version_unverified: app name matched but NVD lacks usable version-range data.

last_seen_at.description: When the CVE was last confirmed by the sync worker for this device/app.

updates.description: Available app updates sourced from the updater catalog (app_catalog_entries). One entry per installed app whose version differs from the catalog's latest_version. Ordered by app_name. Empty array when all apps are current or the catalog has no entry for the app.

identifier.description: Bundle ID (macOS) or MSI product code / registry uninstall key (Windows).

current_version.description: Version string currently installed on the device.

target_version.description: Latest known-good version from the catalog.

linked_cve_ids.description: CVE IDs from device_cve_findings that affect this app at current_version. Updating to target_version is expected to close these CVEs. Empty array when no CVEs link.

app_policy.description: Per-app policy resolution and drift findings for this device. Sourced from tenant_app_policies (PAT-470). apps contains every installed app that has a configured policy; apps without a policy entry are omitted. drift lists advisory violations (mandatory app missing, unapproved app present).

apps.description: Installed apps with their resolved policy. Omits apps not in the tenant policy store.

user_removable.description: False when policy is mandatory — agent should not offer to uninstall.

enforcement_tier.description: Tier at which enforcement acts may be taken. report = advisory only. report_deploy/patch are the canonical names (PAT-1121); report/app_management are deprecated legacy aliases still accepted during the Windows-agent dual-accept migration window.

drift.description: Advisory policy violation findings. mandatory_missing: a mandatory app is absent from this device. unapproved_present: an unapproved app is installed.

enforcement_tier.description: report_deploy/patch are canonical (PAT-1121); report/app_management are deprecated legacy aliases accepted during the Windows-agent migration window.
